newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says no gas well fire damage.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says no gas well fire damage.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said a fire which burned overnight at the surface of an ethane storage well in the Moomba area, in northern South Australia, had not affected production or caused any material damage.
Santos general manager, corporate affairs Graeme Bethune said the fire, believed to have been caused by a lightning strike on Thursday, was put out on Friday.
"It was a small fire on the pipe work at the surface of an ethane storage well," he told Reuters.
There was no threat to gas supplies, no impact on production an no risk to the environment or workers, he said, adding he could not put a cost to damage which was minimal.
